correctness.rationale: At kappa=m the column generator has nonzero eigenvalues -gamma(1+m) ± i gamma delta, and the exact stationary left probability is p=(delta^2+delta+m^2+m)/((1+m)^2+delta^2). The stationary covariance is p times the difference between the L-to-L transition probability and p. Its value and derivative at zero are p(1-p) and -gamma(1-delta)p, giving exactly the cosine and sine coefficients in the record with B/A tending to m. The first zero is at phase pi/2, and the subsequent first trough at pi/2+arctan(omega/Gamma) with the same phase shift; each later trough is reduced by exp(-2 pi Gamma/omega). The trough prefactor is of order delta, so only the exponential contributes to delta log M. For fixed reservoir occupancies, maximizing delta^2-(kappa-m)^2 proves precisely frequency optimality, not amplitude or detectability optimality. The checks are analytic; the supplied checker and verification notes were inspected, not executed.
